decisions: Scene measured as portrait (1 face large enough to retouch).
Vibrance unchanged: the frame is already colourful (45% average saturation).
Tonal range stretched (whites +0, blacks -9): the frame used only 10%-87% of the range.
Sharpening 20 with 70% edge masking so skin texture is not exaggerated.
White balance kept: not enough reliable neutral areas.
Colour fringing: 5584 clean edges in 7 directions show the colour channels in register (red -0.07 px, blue +0.03 px at the corners), so nothing is corrected.
Purple fringes: 20 pixels along bright edges read as a lens's rim, too few to correct.
Scene measured as portrait (1 face large enough to retouch).
Highlights +0 (the histogram asked for -13): under 0.1% of the skin on the detected faces is at or near white, so the bright tones are the scene's own and lowering them would grey them.
Tonal range stretched (whites +0, blacks -7): the frame used only 9%-93% of the range.
Sized from the frame's regions - Highlights -20: 31% is in bright regions that still carry detail, reaching 2.4 stops above it. Both act on whole regions, so the texture inside them is kept.
Sharpening 20 with 70% edge masking so skin texture is not exaggerated.
White balance kept: not enough reliable neutral areas.
Colour fringing: 7130 clean edges in 7 directions show the colour channels in register (red -0.14 px, blue +0.09 px at the corners), so nothing is corrected.
Purple fringes: 28 pixels along bright edges read as a lens's rim, too few to correct.

qualificationProvenance.explanation: Frontend source and command registrations match the earlier frozen source; native and desktop scenarios rerun after sidecar repairs.

initialNativeAttempt.reason: The initial run reproduced the repeated-colour-save history defect. The corrected target passed, and the complete corrected-source workspace run supersedes the older run. Stopping the older run avoids competing disk access.

qualificationProvenance.crashCause: Unconfirmed; sessions closed within seconds. No matching Windows Application crash record or shell panic was found.

fixes.tool: Levels, selective colour and local colour
fixes.problem: An identical save appended an Undo entry despite unchanged canonical settings.
fixes.resolution: Validate first, compare decoded controls and canonical recipe hashes before merging.
fixes.regression: Repeated and subprecision saves preserve recipe hash, history and reversible pixels.

fixes.problem: Requested sidecars were omitted; bounded status reasons could also lose their count.
fixes.resolution: Carry the exact rendered recipe through output processing and retain delivery facts ahead of optional reasons.
fixes.regression: Parallel resized exports and real application exports preserve matching recipes and accurate counts.

limits: Functional tests do not establish visual perfection or exact Evoto equivalence.
300 lab editing methods are tested individually on a synthetic fixture and one supplied RAW-derived proxy.
Every individual method is not rendered at full RAW resolution on every original.
All 27 saved RAW edits are re-rendered and fully exported by the final executable.
Cloud providers, external accounts, physical tethering and hardware-dependent paths are not all exercised.
Ignored native tests remain ignored; see the native case CSV for reasons.
The executable is an unoptimized Windows debug build; concurrent validation timings are not release performance benchmarks.
Some global spatial methods use reduced working grids; diagnostic measurements use a 512-pixel preview.
Several WebView sessions closed unexpectedly; failed attempts are retained. Root cause is unconfirmed.
